title: Rename rollback script and timeout variable (demo PR #482)
notes: Demo scenario from demo/seed/payments-api. The anchored script is renamed and ROLLBACK_TIMEOUT becomes ROLLBACK_TIMEOUT_SECS. The runbook must flag High and get a rename proposal. The scaling guide and the repo-wide architecture page must not flag.

pages.title: Payments rollback runbook
pages.storage:
Use this when a payments-api release misbehaves. Script: scripts/rollback.sh.

Steps

  1. Check the release history with helm history payments.

  2. If the default of 300 seconds is too short, raise ROLLBACK_TIMEOUT. Its default lives in deploy/helm/values.yaml.

  3. Run the rollback:

bash

pages.storage:
payments-api is a Node service deployed with Helm on the shared cluster. Source: payments-api.

@@ -1,9 +1,9 @@
 #!/usr/bin/env bash
 # Roll back payments-api to the previous Helm release.
-# Usage: ./scripts/rollback.sh --timeout $ROLLBACK_TIMEOUT
+# Usage: ./scripts/rollback-v2.sh --timeout $ROLLBACK_TIMEOUT_SECS
